text:
marta (PM): Quick sync for ACME pilot (target 2026-04-01). Need to lock minimal launch scope + cross-team gates: runtime KV change, CMK onboarding, staging prewarm. Who owns each?

alex (Eng): I can own runtime. Need an acceptance checklist. Is temporary canary without CMK acceptable?

sam (Runtime): Canary without CMK ok if fallback isolates tenant data and emits audit events. FYI KV change may add ~8ms p95; will run a perf sweep.

jess (Infra): Prewarm options: burstable hosted (quick, quota request ~3d) or Dedicated pool (provisioning ~1wk + ticket). Recommend burstable to move faster.

casey (SRE): If burstable, set alert: sustained_utilization > 70% for 2h -> conversion runbook. Ill own runbook and alerting.

li (Security): CMK onboarding requires HSM onboarding + key-rotation policy. Earliest review slot 2026-03-18. If canary runs without CMK, provide data-separation design + encryption-in-transit evidence.

alex (Eng): Draft acceptance checklist: 1) E2E generation on ACME test tenant with prefix cache; 2) simulated KMS failure validated; 3) staging p95 < 120ms; 4) canary flag + rollback path.

marta (PM): Add: 5) security sign-off (li) and 6) infra prewarm applied (jess).

sam (Runtime): Ill post perf matrix + tuning suggestions by Fri EOD; adaptive batching looks promising if p95 high.

jess (Infra): Opening INFRA-4321 and starting quota request today. ETA: pool ready ~48h after quota approval.

li (Security): Need design doc + threat model by Thu noon for review. If delayed, list temporary mitigations.

casey (SRE): maintenance window 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC — canary deploys blocked then. Will note in runbook.

marta (PM): Action items: alex: delivery plan + rollback flag (Thu COB); sam: perf matrix (Fri EOD); jess: INFRA-4321 + provision; li: security review slot; casey: alert & runbook. Reply with "ack" if you accept.

alex (Eng): ack

sam (Runtime): ack; posting perf to /perf/results

jess (Infra): ack; INFRA-4321 link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4321

deploy-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC.

marta (PM): Thanks team, Ill compile a launch checklist and post dates after Thu updates.
